summary: Executed backend regression checks and live Playwright coverage for OTP login, dashboard, inventory search/add, customer filter/add, order placement/history, and mobile overflow. Core happy paths pass, but required stock/customer editing and delivery status controls are missing; mobile order summary is severely collapsed.

minor.issue: Order creation does not validate requested quantities against stock and can decrement inventory below zero.
PUT uses upsert=True and can create an unintended customer for a nonexistent ID.
Demo auth has no expiry, attempt throttling/lockout, or server-backed session cookie; the frontend relies on localStorage.

ui_bugs.issue: Order summary renders at about 72px wide inside a 318px content area, causing extreme text wrapping. The global aside width rule applies to the semantic <aside class="order-summary">.
No stock/price/availability edit control exists; only add product is available despite stock update being required.
Edit customer buttons render but have no onClick/action, so customer detail update is unavailable.
No delivery-status update UI is present despite API support for status updates.

integration_issues.issue: UI only exposes All societies, Prestige Ozone, Palm Meadows, and Brigade Gateway; Sobha Dream Acres and Godrej Woods from the fixed API list cannot be filtered.

action_items: Fix mobile .order-summary sizing by overriding the global aside width or using a dedicated class selector.
Implement inventory edit flow for stock, price, and availability and connect it to PUT /api/products/{id}.
Implement customer edit modal and connect it to PUT /api/customers/{id}.
Add order delivery-status controls connected to PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status.
Expose all five society filters and validate order quantities against available stock.
critical_code_review_comments: The UI claims management coverage but exposes only create/search/filter/ordering; update endpoints are effectively unreachable from the seller workspace.
The generic global aside CSS selector unintentionally styles the order summary semantic aside and breaks mobile layout.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (happy paths pass; required management/status/mobile checks fail)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST Oat Milk and TEST Customer through the UI, and placed one demo order for Riya Menon; these remain in the preview database because no delete endpoints are available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP, dashboard, inventory search/add, customer filter/add, order total/placement/history, and no-horizontal-overflow were exercised. Re-test all missing update/status flows and mobile order summary after fixes.
rca of the issue: Mobile collapse reproduces at 390x844 on Orders: .order-summary is an HTML aside, while App.css applies aside{width:248px} and at max-width:900px aside{width:72px}; these rules override the one-column grid sizing. Missing management actions are implementation gaps: Product cards have no edit button, customer edit buttons have no handler, and OrderList renders status as a noninteractive span.
